name: fmp_symbol_changes
description:
Recent ticker symbol changes from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): old and new symbol, company name and date (renames, mergers).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/symbol-change as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
To look up a current ticker use fmp_symbol_search.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
